name: Billabong Surf Capsule Salty Dayz 3/2 Full Suit - Black - Pant suits
description: Women's Billabong Surf Capsule Salty Dayz 3/2 Full Suit - Black - Pant suits Even if things are slightly less than tropical, you can keep the island vibes coming strong with the Billabong Surf Capsule Salty Dayz 3/2 Women's Full Wetsuit. The print might be warm, but the 3/2 thickness is optimized for brisk waters and easy stretch, while key points have been reinforced with heat tape to improve durability. Billabong constructed the Surf Capsule from a blend of neoprene and nylon for extra toughness and stretch, and it and triple-glued and blind-stitched each and every internal seam to make sure they don't pull apart or allow cold water in. It finished the suit with an easy-opening chest zip, too, so you can get into your suit without employing an army of friends to help pull it up. 3/2mm neoprene and nylon blend. Chest zip. Twin needle stitching. Triple-glued and blind-stitched internal seams. Heat tape stress points.
